description: Find bugs in frename before the owner does, UI bugs first. Use in every nightly session (step "Bug hunt" of the nightly skill), or when asked to "look for bugs", "check the UI", "audit". Screenshots every reachable screen at several sizes and languages, audits the code against the project skills' rules, looks for siblings of past bugs, verifies each finding, files it as a `bug` issue that the nightly pipeline then fixes without waiting for approval.
